seo.title: Work with ODD — membership, agency & partnerships
seo.description: Several ways for organisations to build a relationship with ODD — attend ODDference, join as a member, commission ODDagency, or build a partnership.

title: Work with ODD.
intro: There are several ways to build a relationship with ODD — from a single ticket to a year-round partnership. Wherever you start, you're working with the same network of creative professionals and platforms.

whyOdd.title: Access to creative expertise
whyOdd.body: A real network of creative professionals across disciplines, not a directory.

whyOdd.title: Cross-sector capability
whyOdd.body: ODD moves between creative, business and public-sector contexts by design — most consultancies or agencies only really work in one.

whyOdd.title: Real communities & platforms
whyOdd.body: Connected directly to ODDfest, ODDference and ODDspace, not a service built on top of nothing.

pathways.title: ODDference
pathways.body: Attend, bring a team, or partner with ODD's flagship professional event.

pathways.title: ODDmembership
pathways.body: A year-round relationship with ODD and its wider network — still being defined.

pathways.title: ODDagency
pathways.body: Bring us a brief and we'll assemble the right creative team for it.

pathways.title: Partnerships
pathways.body: Co-create something across ODD's events, spaces or wider activity.

howWeWork.title: Start a conversation
howWeWork.body: Tell us what you're working on — there's no wrong way in.

howWeWork.title: Find the right pathway
howWeWork.body: Together we work out whether that's ODDference, membership, an agency project, or a partnership.

howWeWork.title: Build together
howWeWork.body: We shape the specifics from there — the exact form depends on what you actually need.

network.title: Organisations building with ODD
network.note: A growing list of organisations already building with ODD — see the partners below, with more joining as the network grows.

contact.title: Tell us what you're working on.
contact.body: Tell us what you're working on, or what you're trying to figure out — the form below goes straight to the team.
